title: feat(spec): the position form picks permissionSets from the permission-set registry (ref-multi:permission)
body:
Fixes #22682
Clause-②: no

Item 3 of #22682, the card's last `packages/spec` item (items 1 and 2 landed with PR #22710 as `b32ee3eaf3`). ADR-0131 D4, verbatim: "References to declared items are **by machine name**, resolved registry-first." The position form is the one authoring surface for the position to permission-set binding, and its `permissionSets` row (added by PR #22723 as `type: 'tags'`, a free-text tag box) now names the permission-set registry picker, so the designer can offer the declared set names instead of free text.

Claim `6105901038` (seat `domain:spec#1`), branch `claude/issue-22682-position-permission-sets-picker`, base `e84aeb36ce`.

## What changes

- **The row** (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.form.ts`): `{ field: 'permissionSets', type: 'tags', colSpan: 2, helpText: … }` becomes `{ field: 'permissionSets', widget: 'ref-multi:permission', colSpan: 2, helpText: … }`, with a comment saying why. The helpText is unchanged. No other row, section or form changes.
- **One pin** (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.test.ts`, a new `describe` at the end, 4 tests). It reads the position form through `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`, the registry `/meta/types` serves, which holds the output of `defineForm`'s parse, so a parse that dropped `widget` would also turn it red. It asserts:
  - a lit and a dark control for the row probe;
  - exactly one `permissionSets` row, whose `widget` is `ref-multi:permission`;
  - the registry type the key names is `permission`, and `getMetadataTypeSchema('permission')` is `PermissionSetSchema`;
  - `permissionSets` refuses a bare string with `invalid_type` at `permissionSets`, so the list-valued key sits on a list-valued field.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`.
- ⛔ No schema, parse, export or accept-set change. `PositionSchema` is untouched (`permissionSets` stays `z.array(SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema).optional()`), the approver bindings are untouched, and `FormField.widget` stays `z.string().optional()`: the spec has no form widget-key vocabulary, so no published vocabulary is added. No objectui file.

## The key: `ref-multi:permission`, measured

objectui readings are `git show` in a read-only clone, at objectui `origin/main` `206505c` and at this repo's pin `.objectui-sha` `20c6d351ad74`; both read the same at every line cited.

| question | reading |
|:--|:--|
| Does a multi-value `ref:` spelling exist anywhere? | No. Census of quoted `ref:` widget literals: this repo has `ref:object`, `ref:dataset` and `ref:component` only; objectui has the same three. All three are single-valued. |
| How does the vocabulary spell a multi-value picker? | As its own key: `field-ref` / `field-multi`, `select` / `multiselect`, and `action-multi`. No key in either repo serves both arities. |
| Can objectui's single `ref:` widgets take an array? | No. `RefObjectWidget`, `RefComponentWidget` and `RefDatasetWidget` (`widgets.tsx:464`, `:607`, `:684`) each read `String(value)` and write one string. The registry also declares ONE labelling per key (`WIDGET_LABELLING`, `widgets.tsx:3142`): the single `ref:` pickers are `'control'`, while `field-multi`, `action-multi` and `multiselect` are `'group'`. |
| Which registry type names permission sets? | `permission`, on both sides. Spec: `MetadataTypeSchema` (`kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:166`), the `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` row labelled `Permission Set` (`:1117`), and `getMetadataTypeSchema('permission')` returns `PermissionSetSchema`. objectui: `registerMetadataResource({ type: 'permission', … })` (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:28`), and `anchors.ts:374`. |
| Does `type: 'tags'` override an explicit widget? | No. `inferWidget` returns an explicit `fieldSpec.widget` first (`SchemaForm.tsx:447`). `tags` maps to `string-tags` only when no widget is declared (`:467`). So the row drops `type`, matching every other `ref:` and `-multi` row in the spec forms, none of which declares a `type`. |

So the key is a distinct list key in the `ref:` family. The prefix carries the arity, and the token after the colon is the exact registry type, so the same split reads `ref:object` and `ref-multi:permission`.

Alternatives considered:
- `ref:permission` on the array field, with the arity read from the schema. It is one key per type, but no widget in the vocabulary is arity-polymorphic, a single `ref:` widget writes a string into a list, and one key would have to carry one labelling for two shapes.
- `permission-multi`, mirroring `field-multi`. It drops the `ref:` namespace the claim names.
- `ref:permission-multi`. The token after the colon would no longer be a registry type.

## What objectui renders for this key today, and the landing order

Measured by code path at both objectui commits above:
- The position editor is the generic `ResourceEditPage`. Its form is `entry?.form` from `/meta/types` (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:456`, `:457`, `:2943`). Position registers only a preview (`previews/index.ts:87`), not an edit page. So the key reaches every console as soon as the server runs this spec.
- `WIDGETS` (`widgets.tsx:3033`) has no `ref-multi:permission` entry. `resolveFieldFace` therefore sends an unregistered, non-passthrough hint to the `raw-json` face (`SchemaForm.tsx:870`), rendered at `:2223`: a JSON textarea under the note `widget ref-multi:permission — falling back to JSON until a custom renderer is registered.` (`i18n.ts:2166`).
- The face is pinned by objectui's `SchemaForm.nonRegistryLabelling.test.tsx` (case `(fallback) raw-json / unregistered widget hint`). The textarea still writes a JSON list of names, so the stored value keeps its shape. But the row goes from today's tag box to a JSON box until objectui registers the key and the pin moves past it.
- No objectui test pins "every widget key a spec form names is registered". The key-set parities are internal (`SchemaForm.widgetLabelling.test.tsx:181`, `:199`). The core validator's namespace refusal covers the runtime form renderer's `fields[].type`, a different shape that its own header (`schema-validator.ts:390`) separates from this table. So this change turns no objectui gate red; it degrades to the announced fallback.
- Precedent: objectui#11601 records the same shape for `ref:dataset` (a declared hint with no `WIDGETS` entry rendered the raw-JSON face), and the joined-block row in #21714 declared `ref:dataset` only after the pin carried the renderer.

The landing order is the seat's to set (see the report's open question). The objectui side needs nothing from this PR: the key is a string objectui owns, and the `permission` catalog exists today.

**objectui companion, for the seat to file:** register `ref-multi:permission` in metadata-admin.
- `widgets.tsx`: a `WIDGETS` entry, a `WIDGET_LABELLING` entry, a `WidgetContext` catalog member for the permission-set names, and the widget. It offers the declared names, commits each pick's name, and keeps a stored name the catalog lacks visible and flagged, as `RefDatasetWidget` does.
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx`: feeds the `permission` list into `widgetContext`.
- `SchemaForm.widgetLabelling.test.tsx`: its `CASES` roster must name every `WIDGETS` key (`:199`). A `'control'` declaration also enters `__tests__/SchemaForm.controlWidgetFailureArmNaming-9931.test.tsx`, whose population is the table.

## Tests and gates

Head `8996b566b5` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`). Every build and test went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Each result below is quoted from its `VERDICT` line or from the gate's own verdict line.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0. The build left the tree clean.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 645 passed (645)`, `Tests 19226 passed | 1 todo (19227)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, the scripts program, and the test layer under `tsconfig.test.json`, whose `include` is `src/**/*` with no test exclusion): VERDICT command-exit 0. Its test-layer line reads `52 file(s) / 246 error(s) / 135 pinned signature(s) held`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity/position.test.ts`: `Tests 23 passed (23)`.
- **Ablation** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, on the committed head. The anchor `{ field: 'permissionSets', widget: 'ref-multi:permission',` went 1 to 0 and the replacement `{ field: 'permissionSets', type: 'tags',` went 0 to 1; the blob went `62270c8d2388` to `9776a96594c8`. The pin then went red: `Tests 2 failed | 21 passed (23)`. The two failures were the widget pin and the registry-type pin; the controls and the list pin stayed green, as expected. The restore was proven by the blob equal to HEAD's `62270c8d2388` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The restore leg re-ran green at 23 of 23. No dist leg was needed: the test imports the form from source by relative path.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run with no paths, derives 86 commands; the derivation at `8996b566b5` is identical. All 86 were run with exit codes recorded, plus `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` (`All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`).
  - `--ran` reads `86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
  - Four gates first refused with exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, which is not a reading: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. All four exit 0 after a turbo build of their closures. That build's first attempt failed on `plugin-webhooks` DTS reading `service-messaging` before its declarations were emitted, a build-order race; the re-run went `59 successful, 59 total`. `check:i18n` reads `all bundles in sync`: the row's label and helpText did not move, so no translation bundle changes.
  - The changeset-reading families were re-run on `8996b566b5`, the changeset's final wording, all exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration` (`no declared-breaking changeset`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check:nul-bytes`, among others.
- `pnpm lint` (eslint over the repo) is CI's run and was not run locally.
- NOT MEASURED, declared for CI: the five path-scheduled CI jobs (`Test Core`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Build Core`) and the four workspace type-check lanes the derivation names as having no local invocation. `@objectstack/spec`'s `test:repo` project is not named by the derivation and was not run.

Size: 3 files, +60 / −1 (61 changed lines) against `e84aeb36ce`.

## Acceptance notes

- `origin/main` moved to `a2e94c2a05` during the run with two commits: an ADR document and the skills package's changeset config. Neither touches `packages/spec/src`. The branch was not re-merged, and CI's merge ref covers the join.
- The helpText ("Permission sets this position distributes, by name (snake_case).") is deliberately unchanged. It stays true under a picker, under objectui's freeform fallback, and under the raw-JSON face. Rewording it would move the `en` metadata-forms bundle and three hand-translated locales, which are outside this claim's file surface.
